items.q: Luther Henderson is the name I was trying to think.

ctx.x: Speaking of Broadway, how did you become involved with Ain’t Misbehavin?

Well, that is a good question too. Who was the writer, think it was the arranger that used to arrange for Duke Ellington. He just passed away recently. He is a very fine arranger. I think he was on the called me. Anyway, they had been doing this off Broadway show, Ain’t Misbehaving, at one of the theatres off Broadway. That's where they broke the show in, Ain’t Misbehavin’. The show came to Broadway. Luther Henderson is the name I was trying to think. Luther called me and said, "Would you like to do this Broadway…
also used to play a lot. They didn’t feature the music, the instrumental music as much as they featured the singers because that is what the Broadway show is all about.

items.q: until such time as we could get a suitable replacement who played the show awhile for us whose name is Hank Jones whom you may have heard of.

ctx.x: Was it March? It was around that time and so we had a couple of months before … I know I had to get special dispensation from the union to play. I played the Broadway opening again because as we arrived, there's no other musical … I'm all the

musical departments, do you know what I mean? I'd be the orchestration, had to do arrangements, I'm playing the piano and now I do some arrangements for a small group, I did that. And there was copy. I did not copy the things. But other than that, so that there's a rule in the union book that I guess it's dissipated so that if you are involved in an area of music preparation, that you can't be in the music preparation and the music as a performer as well because that should be jobs for two people, not just for…
Name some of the great Fats Waller compositions that you had the pleasure of playing.
